info.accent_colors: Use at most 1–2 accent colors per screen (docs/01).

announcement.name: MORU announcement bar
announcement.text_default: Free shipping over ¥15,000 / ¥500 in points when you sign up

header.name: MORU header
header.logo_info: The logo stays replaceable from settings until trademark clearance. Shows the store name when unset.
header.sale_link_title_info: A menu link with this exact title is shown in the sale color. Leave empty to disable
header.show_login_info: Shows the log in link in the header (requires customer accounts)
header.wordmark_info: Shown when no logo image is set. Leave empty to use the store name

When the cat lies down,
